borges_role: Recurring symbol of doubling, infinity, dread. 'Mirrors and copulation are abominable, for they multiply the number of men.' — Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius
Core Borgesian topology — library, garden of forking paths, the universe itself.

etymology.note: possibly from Lydian labrys (double axe), the Cretan royal emblem

gloss: outskirts, edge neighborhood (often poetic — the periphery of a city, esp. Buenos Aires)
borges_role: The geography of Fervor de Buenos Aires. Borges's arrabales are not slums but liminal zones where the city meets the pampa.

etymology.note: one of ~4,000 Spanish words of Arabic origin — legacy of 800 years of al-Andalus

borges_role: 'I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.' Borges directed the Biblioteca Nacional 1955–1973.
Borges's central obsession — 'Time is the substance from which I am made.' One word, three meanings (chronos, weather, grammar) is itself a Borgesian gift.
